phrase.zh: 熟悉的事物里，仍藏着新的发现。
phrase.en: Familiar things can still hold new discoveries.

visual.zh: 放大的椒剖面在左侧形成拱形空腔，内壁和上方附着的籽粒围住一枚有切面的晶体；右侧留出空白。
visual.en: An enlarged pepper section forms a hollow arch at the left. Its inner ribs and attached seeds surround a faceted crystal, with quiet space on the right.

background.zh:
圣捷尔吉因关于生物氧化过程的发现，尤其涉及维生素C和富马酸的催化作用，获得1937年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，独享该奖。他发现红椒是丰富的维生素C来源。画面用剖开的椒包住一枚放大晶体，表达从熟悉植物中辨认出一种物质；这是获奖研究中维生素C部分的原创寓意，不是提取步骤或晶体尺寸的复原，也不表示食品或补充剂的治疗效果。短句为原创。
1937年生理学或医学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：关于生物氧化过程的发现，尤其涉及维生素C和富马酸的催化作用
background.en:
Szent-Gyorgyi received the sole 1937 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for discoveries concerning biological oxidation, particularly vitamin C and fumaric-acid catalysis. He identified paprika as a rich source of vitamin C. A hollow pepper sheltering an oversized crystal symbolizes identifying a substance in a familiar plant. This original metaphor focuses on the vitamin C part of his research, not an extraction procedure or actual crystal size, and makes no treatment claim about food or supplements. The phrase is original.
1937 — The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his discoveries in connection with the biological combustion processes, with special reference to vitamin C and the catalysis of fumaric acid
